answer: The nectar index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 477 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the anchor. Flooding registration pushes an hostile operator to the back of the ivory queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
